name: check-list
title: Check List
description: A handwritten checklist that writes itself out, then ticks and strikes through every done item.
useWhen: A list of features, steps, or done-items should be read in full and then crossed off in a hand-made scene.
One line in the list has not landed yet: mark it checked false and it stays clean.
avoidWhen: Labels need to wrap across lines, or the list needs numbering or nesting. One label, one line.
The list should sit at an angle or wobble: wrap it in paper-wobble.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Items
variables.description: JSON array of list items: a string (ticked) or an object with text and checked. One line per label.
variables.default: ["Render on your own machine","No watermark, ever","Every component MIT",{"text":"Ships as source","checked":false}]

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Label size in px on a 1280 by 720 layout; the whole list scales to fit the frame.

variables.label: List width
variables.description: Row width in px on the 1280 by 720 layout.

variables.label: Item gap
variables.description: Frames between items starting to write.

variables.label: Close gap
variables.description: Frames between ticks when the done items are crossed off.

variables.label: Frame step
variables.description: Stop-motion step: motion updates every this many frames.
